This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their long [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] that covered almost all of their faces aside from their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], as well as sometimes a white horn extending from the top of their heads. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least one member of this species could be found in the city [[Wrils]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]],<ref name="MJ1" /> and another worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Allic]] at a [[Casino on Qiaxx|casino]] on the planet [[Qiaxx]].<ref name="MJ5">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 5|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 5]]</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ1" />
